name: Groth Jonar
description: An orcish general who kills Elkan and claims the Kjeldoran battle standard.

description_citations.text: "The Colors of Magic". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jonar sends the goblins against the Kjeldorans first, then attacks, routing the knights; he kills Elkan when he intervenes.
timeline.quote: Jonar kills him and then lets the remaining knights leave without further harm

citation.text: "The Colors of Magic", section "The Crucible of the Orcs , by Don Perrin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Groth Jonar and his orcs found a shattered clockwork avian atop a peak.
timeline.quote: a shattered, ancient clockwork avian was encountered by Groth Jonar and his orcs

citation.text: "Clockwork creature", section "Brothers' War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
